page.overview:
Who is Ashley (Lisa the Boy Scout)?

Ashley is a character, she is a fan of The Simpsons who along with her Male Counterpart hacked the show showing unaired clips that will "ruin the series" until a fine was given, she is a part of the hacker group Pseudo-Nonymous, she and her male counterpart became a couple at the end of the episode.
